scientific_integrity: Analytic derivation plus standalone reproducible exact-fraction and independent quadrature checks. Qualitative OA failure and general infinite-cumulant theory are acknowledged as prior results.
scientific_limitations: Single weak-kick update, fixed harmonic order, interior Poisson kernel; no long-time propagation, global closure or independent priority verification.
title: Universal quadratic circular-cumulant cascade under a discrete Kuramoto phase kick
